title: Expose the generator contract through a stdio MCP adapter
narrative: Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients should drive the same start/resume/inspect/cancel/list_recipes contract over piped stdio without embedding core semantics in the transport. Stdout stays protocol; diagnostics go to stderr. Tracks R-IOC-MCP[^insp-ioc-09].
implementation: `mechaharness.mcp_graph_driver.GeneratorMcpServer` is a stdio MCP adapter (newline-delimited JSON-RPC, with Content-Length fallback) mapping `generator_start` / `generator_resume` / `generator_inspect` / `generator_cancel` / `generator_list_recipes` onto `DurableGraphGenerator`. Run with `python -m mechaharness.mcp_graph_driver`. File-backed `FileGeneratorRunStore` keeps state outside the MCP process. End-to-end IoC example lives in the module doctest (pytest `--doctest-modules`).
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_mcp_gap`. Hard expects mcp_adapter_shipped true. Pytest `--doctest-modules` on `mechaharness.mcp_graph_driver` covers start → advice → store restart → resume → completed plus NDJSON initialize/tools/list. Unit framing cases: `tests/test_mcp_graph_driver.py`.
